faqs.question: What is Father of Insane™?

faqs.question: Who should use Father of Insane™?
faqs.answer: Father of Insane™ is intended for healthy adults with prior experience using stimulant-containing pre-workout supplements. It is not recommended for beginners or individuals who are sensitive to caffeine or other stimulants.

faqs.question: How do I take Father of Insane™?
faqs.answer: Begin with ½ scoop mixed with 4–6 oz (120–180 ml) of water approximately 30 minutes before workout to assess tolerance. If well tolerated, use 1 full scoop with 8–10 oz (240–300 ml) of water approximately 30 minutes before your workout. Do not exceed one scoop per day.

faqs.question: What are the main benefits of Father of Insane™?
faqs.answer: The formula is designed to support workout energy, mental focus, muscle pump, exercise endurance, strength-oriented training, and high-intensity workouts. Results vary depending on the individual, training program, nutrition, and consistency.

faqs.question: Does Father of Insane™ contain creatine?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes Creatine Monohydrate and Creatine HCl (CreaCCL®), two forms of creatine commonly used in sports nutrition to support high-intensity exercise performance.

faqs.question: Does Father of Insane™ contain caffeine?
faqs.answer: Yes. The product includes multiple caffeine sources, including Caffeine Anhydrous, Dicaffeine Malate (2XCAFF®), and Caffeine Citrate (Citra Caff®). The label also notes a total caffeine content of 450 mg per serving.

faqs.question: Can I take Father of Insane™ every day?
faqs.answer: Follow the directions on the label and do not exceed one serving per day. Many athletes also adjust their supplement routines based on training intensity and individual tolerance. Consult a healthcare professional if you have questions about regular use.
